title: macos: fix a cache returning stale data after a backend update
scenario: On macos, a hard operational problem: Una cache (Redis/HTTP) serve dati stali dopo un aggiornamento del backend. Correggi l'invalidazione senza svuotare tutto ripetutamente. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix a cache returning stale data after a backend update

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'fix a cache returning stale data after a backend update'
expected_reasoning: Stale-after-update is a cache-invalidation bug: the write path doesn't invalidate/refresh the key.
Trace which key serves stale data and why it isn't invalidated (TTL-only, missing bust, wrong key).
Fix invalidation on write (or a correct TTL) so freshness holds without flushing everything.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix a cache returning stale data after a backend update
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix a cache returning stale data after a backend update' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix a cache returning stale data after a backend update

possible_mistakes: Flush the entire cache on every update (kills hit rate).
Rely on a long TTL and serve stale.
hints: Invalidate on write, don't just wait for TTL.
Key mismatch between read and write is common.
reference_solution: Fix invalidation on the write path
alternative_solution: Use versioned keys so a new version naturally supersedes the old.
edge_cases: Read and write compute the cache key differently, so busts miss.
goal: Una cache (Redis/HTTP) serve dati stali dopo un aggiornamento del backend. Correggi l'invalidazione senza svuotare tutto ripetutamente.
